_comment: Synthetic cases only. Each rule lists phrases that must stay in the skill text; each case names the rule that decides it. 'only' limits a rule to one skill.

must_contain: Substantive claims must match a ledger row
Ordinary factual statements are not blocked for lacking an accomplishment row
becomes substantive as soon as it carries a result
The ledger is authoritative for claims it already covers
do not silently override the ledger
Record a ledger conflict for adjudication
Never silently override the canonical ledger with new evidence; flag the conflict for adjudication.
SHIP AS-IS requires a completed Live Ledger Gate
Never issue SHIP AS-IS without the Live Ledger Gate.
The locked resume does not outrank the ledger
Never issue READY, or hand off an architecture, without the Live Ledger Gate.

cases.sentence: 94% of members who hit the threshold renewed.
cases.ledger: Figure unverified as an observed outcome; omit until reconciled.

cases.sentence: Built a churn-prediction model for dormant accounts.
cases.ledger: Rebuilt an inherited re-engagement campaign. NOT a predictive churn model.
(no accomplishment row; tool listed in master resume)

cases.sentence: Used Looker to cut reporting time 40%.
User now says the threshold analysis was his own.
cases.ledger: Finding established by an analyst; user applied it.
cases.expect: conflict flagged for adjudication; document uses ledger version
